value: This article introduces Arc Max, a suite of powerful AI features integrated into the Arc browser, designed to enhance the browsing experience and save users time. Users can easily activate Max by pressing Cmd + T and selecting desired functionalities. Key features include AI-powered "Ask on Page" for instant answers from web content, "5 Second Previews" for quick link insights without clicking, direct "Ask ChatGPT" integration, automatic "Tidy Tab Titles" for pinned tabs, and "Tidy Downloads" for better file organization. Collectively, Max aims to streamline navigation and improve productivity within the Arc browser.
